title: Velvety Juicy Thai Tofu Khanom Krok
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Thai dish featuring slow-cooked tofu and shichimi-togarashi, served in a cazuela.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, Thai red curry paste, fish-free sauce, palm sugar, and salt.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the marinated tofu until golden brown.
Transfer the cooked tofu to a cazuela and add the shichimi-togarashi and kaffir lime leaves.
Pour the remaining marinade over the tofu and cover the cazuela with a lid.
Transfer the cazuela to the preheated oven and slow-cook for 20 minutes.
While the tofu is cooking, prepare the khanom krok molds by brushing them with vegetable oil.
Remove the cazuela from the oven and carefully pour the tofu mixture into the prepared khanom krok molds.
Serve the Velvety Juicy Thai Tofu Khanom Krok hot, garnished with additional kaffir lime leaves if desired.
